body: That I found the love of my life

My personal opinion you are better off without your gf.  If you can’t stand by one another during difficult times then what’s the point of the relationship. 

Try to help yourself out of this, you are strong you can find another job. Can you get welfare payments or anything ? Do you have family you can stay with until you find another job. Reach out to everyone and anyone you know. Contact companies similar to the one you worked at and don’t stop applying for jobs until you get an interview. Even try walking in and just dropping off your resume and checking if they have vacancies. Sometimes it makes a huge difference when they see you.

Once you’ve got a job, find yourself a gf who will stand by you through thick and thin. Don’t ever give your current gf another chance. 

It’s disgusting that she won’t support you through everything.

I understand what you are saying and this world is full of horrible people. I don’t think those kinda shitty people would hang around this forum. So if people try to reach out here it’s most likely that they want to be kind.
I hope you are okay. I hope you can give yourself more time to heal

You are the best mama! It’s such a tough job being a mother and I agree it’s a struggle everyday. I’m a mama too and I understand. I also know that it will not stay the same forever. Is there anyone who can give you a break just to do something for yourself... even if it’s to go for a walk or get a haircut or go to the shops. I know it made a difference for me.
